content.title: Aerospace & Defense, Mechatronics | Hanwha
content.text: What We Do From advanced defense platforms and maritime systems to innovative propulsion, satellite, and manufacturing solutions, our integrated capabilities operate across land, sea, air, cyber, and space. We deliver with speed and precision, strengthening operational readiness and securing the industrial systems that underpin global growth. Defense Space Aviation Security Mechatronics Defense Through strategic investment and localized production, we support stronger defense industrial capacity — delivering mission-critical systems at speed and scale Hanwha is advancing integrated defense systems across land, air, sea, cyber, and space. Our land portfolio is anchored by the K9 self-propelled howitzer, which holds the No. 1 global market share, and includes precision-guided munitions and multiple rocket launchers. Through advanced electronics and ICT, we support joint operations between the Army, Navy, and Air Force with new technologies and innovative solutions. In the naval sector, Hanwha is enhancing global competitiveness through submarine and surface vessel construction, as well as maintenance, repair, and overhaul (MRO) services. In 2024, Hanwha became the first in Korea to secure and carry out MRO projects for the U.S. Navy, servicing logistics support vessels including the USNS Wally Schirra, and demonstrating its global MRO capabilities, while reinforcing its role in naval operations and fleet sustainment. That same year, Hanwha acquired the U.S.-based Philly Shipyard, relaunching it as Hanwha Philly Shipyard and establishing a strategic foothold for entry into the U.S. naval shipbuilding market. Our expertise Land systems Precision guided munitions Naval systems Maintenance, repair, and overhaul (MRO) Defense electronics systems Space As Korea’s aerospace pioneer, we’re enhancing connectivityon Earth and beyond to power the new space era As the first private aerospace company heading joint projects to develop innovative proprietary technology, Hanwha is leading Korea into the global ranks for the next phase of the space era. We are building a complete space value chain, including the manufacture of space launch vehicles and satellites. We successfully carried out the third launch of the Korean launch vehicle Nuri in 2023 and the fourth launch in 2025, working closely with the Korea Aerospace Research Institute (KARI) as the system integrator for Korea’s launch vehicle program. Our satellite capabilities include the development of small synthetic aperture radar (SAR) satellites, which can monitor changes in the same location regardless of time or weather. Hanwha also owns small hyperspectral satellite technologies and is advancing tailored satellite solutions through Satrec Initiative, which successfully launched the ultra-high-resolution SpaceEye-T satellite in 2025. By developing Earth observation (EO) satellites and integrating their data with AI technology, Hanwha seeks to provide insights for a wide range of sectors including defense, weather and disaster monitoring, land management, and the maritime industry — predicting changes for the benefit of humanity and the planet. Our expertise Space launch vehicle engines and system integration Earth observation satellite solutions and services Design and manufacture of communication satellites and user terminals Aviation As a trusted manufacturer of aircraft engines, components,and future mobility, our quality and reliability set us apart Over the past 40 years, Hanwha has produced over 10,000 engines for helicopters, naval vessels, guided weapons, and fighter jets. In 2024, Hanwha Aerospace signed a contract with Korea’s Defense Acquisition Program Administration (DAPA) to supply aircraft engines for the initial mass production of the KF-21 fighter jet. Through ongoing technological innovation, we are leading the aerospace engine industry in Korea as one of the world’s top aircraft engine manufacturers, working closely with global aviation engine companies such as Pratt & Whitney, GE, and Rolls-Royce. Beyond this, Hanwha is also advancing its role in the industry through the development of engines and systems for unmanned aerial vehicles (UAV). Our expertise Aircraft engines and engine components Aerospace sensors and electronic systems Platform for aviation leasing, trading, and aero-engine and aircraft asset management Aviation and maritime mobility Satellite communication antennas Security By integrating AI technology, we offer cutting-edge, efficient security solutions that can be tailored to any setting We use AI data analytics to provide safer, more efficient security solutions in areas that range from industry to retail. By combining AI with world-class optical processing and imaging technologies, we’ve become a leader in video surveillance solutions. We are also advancing our cloud-based AIoT platform using AI and machine learning, with the goal of accelerating our transformation into a platform-oriented solutions provider. Our expertise Advanced video surveillance solutions Cloud-based AIoT platforms Mechatronics We’re creating smarter, more connected systemsto power industries and communities Our industrial machinery and equipment, automated engineering solutions, robotics, and innovative secondary battery technology set us apart. Our rechargeable battery equipment provides solutions — from materials to electrodes, assembly, formation, and module pack processes — based on advanced technologies. Hanwha Semitech develops integrated, high-performance semiconductor equipment across both pre- and post-processing stages. We are also advancing automation through Hanwha Momentum and Hanwha Robotics, combining expertise in robotics, precision engineering, and AI-based vision technologies to deliver integrated solutions that support the AI-driven transformation of manufacturing, including smart factory solutions, autonomous mobility systems, and human–machine collaboration tools. Our expertise Industrial equipment and engineering solutions Collaborative robots Rechargeable battery production equipment Pre- and post-processing solutions for semiconductor manufacturing equipment
